            Resolution.Daily

            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        current_spy_close = spy_bar.Close

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and current_spy_close > current_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close > self.previous_spy_close
            if hasattr(self, "previous_spy_close") and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            else False
        )

        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and hasattr(self, "previous_spy_close")
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and current_spy_close < current_spy_sma
        )

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot, "Strategy A liquidation")
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > self.RSI_THRESHOLD:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot, "Strategy B liquidation")
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            quantity = math.floor(
                (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_bar.Close
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity, "Strategy A buy")
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = math.floor(20000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity, "Strategy B buy")
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
        self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close

            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        required_symbols = [
            self.spy,
            self.aapl,
            self.ibm,
            self.bac,
            self.aig
        ]

        all_data_present = all(
            data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in required_symbols
        )

        if (
            data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy)
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
        ):
            current_spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
            current_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)

            if all_data_present:
                indicators_ready = (
                    self.spy_sma.IsReady
                    and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                    and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                    and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                )

                if indicators_ready:
                    spy_buy_signal = (
                        self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                        and current_spy_close > current_spy_sma
                    )

                    spy_sell_signal = (
                        self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                        and current_spy_close < current_spy_sma
                    )

                    if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_sell_signal:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                        self.strategy_a_lot = 0

                    if self.strategy_b_lot > 0:
                        aapl_rsi_sell_signal = (
                            float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value)
                            > self.RSI_THRESHOLD
                        )

                        if aapl_rsi_sell_signal:
                            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

                    if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_buy_signal:
                        target_value = (
                            0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
                        )
                        shares = int(math.floor(target_value / current_spy_close))

                        if shares > 0:
                            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                            self.strategy_a_lot = shares

                    if self.strategy_b_lot == 0:
                        aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
                        aapl_red_day = False

                        history = self.History(
                            self.aapl,
                            4,
                            Resolution.Daily
                        )

                        if not history.empty and "close" in history.columns:
                            closes = list(history["close"])
                            if len(closes) >= 4:
                                aapl_red_day = (
                                    closes[-1] < closes[-2]
                                    and closes[-2] < closes[-3]
                                    and closes[-3] < closes[-4]
                                )

                        if aapl_red_day and float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000:
                            shares = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_close))

                            if shares > 0:
                                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                                self.strategy_b_lot = shares

            self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma

from QuantConnect import *
from QuantConnect.Algorithm import QCAlgorithm
from QuantConnect.Data.Market import TradeBar
from QuantConnect.Indicators import SimpleMovingAverage, RelativeStrengthIndex
from QuantConnect.Orders import OrderStatus
from QuantConnect import IndicatorDataPoint


class TwoSlotStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    RSI_THRESHOLD = 70.0

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        available = set(data.Bars.Keys)

        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if symbol not in available:
                continue

            bar = data.Bars[symbol]
            point = IndicatorDataPoint(symbol, bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

            if symbol == self.spy:
                self.spy_sma.Update(point)
            elif symbol == self.aapl:
                self.aapl_rsi.Update(point)

        current_spy_close = (
            data.Bars[self.spy].Close if self.spy in available else None
        )
        current_aapl_close = (
            data.Bars[self.aapl].Close if self.aapl in available else None
        )

        spy_crosses_above = False
        spy_crosses_below = False
        aapl_sell_reason = False
        aapl_buy_reason = False

        if all(symbol in available for symbol in self.symbols):
            if (
                current_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.spy_sma.IsReady
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            ):
                current_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

                spy_crosses_above = (
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and current_spy_close > current_sma
                )

                spy_crosses_below = (
                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and current_spy_close < current_sma
                )

            if (
                current_aapl_close is not None
                and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
            ):
                aapl_buy_reason = self.aapl_red_streak >= 2

            if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
                aapl_sell_reason = (
                    self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > self.RSI_THRESHOLD
                )

            # Evaluate sells before buys.
            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
                quantity = self.strategy_a_lot
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -quantity, tag="Strategy A Sell")
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
                quantity = self.strategy_b_lot
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -quantity, tag="Strategy B Sell")
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
                close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
                quantity = int(
                    (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) // close
                )

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity, tag="Strategy A Buy")
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and aapl_buy_reason:
                close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                    quantity = int(20000 // close)

                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(
                            self.aapl, quantity, tag="Strategy B Buy"
                        )
                        self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if self.spy in available:
            self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if self.aapl in available:
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if current_aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = current_aapl_close

class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    RSI_EXIT_THRESHOLD = 70.0

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_bar_valid = False

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.previous_aapl_bar_valid = False
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy_bar = data.Bars.get(self.spy)
        aapl_bar = data.Bars.get(self.aapl)

        if spy_bar is not None:
            spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_spy_bar_valid and self.previous_spy_close is not None:
                spy_crosses_above = (
                    self.spy_sma.IsReady
                    and self.spy_sma.Window.Count >= 2
                    and self.previous_spy_close <= self.spy_sma.Window[1].Value
                    and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )
                spy_crosses_below = (
                    self.spy_sma.IsReady
                    and self.spy_sma.Window.Count >= 2
                    and self.previous_spy_close >= self.spy_sma.Window[1].Value
                    and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )
            else:
                spy_crosses_above = False
                spy_crosses_below = False

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_bar_valid = True
        else:
            spy_crosses_above = False
            spy_crosses_below = False
            self.previous_spy_bar_valid = False

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_bar_valid and self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            aapl_buy_reason = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            aapl_sell_reason = (
                self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > self.RSI_EXIT_THRESHOLD
            )

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
            self.previous_aapl_bar_valid = True
        else:
            aapl_buy_reason = False
            aapl_sell_reason = False
            self.previous_aapl_bar_valid = False
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        required_symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in required_symbols):
            return

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
            quantity = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and aapl_buy_reason:
            aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    RSI_EXIT_THRESHOLD = 70.0

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_bar_valid = False

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.previous_aapl_bar_valid = False
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy_bar = data.Bars.get(self.spy)
        aapl_bar = data.Bars.get(self.aapl)

        if spy_bar is not None:
            spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_spy_bar_valid and self.previous_spy_close is not None:
                spy_crosses_above = (
                    self.spy_sma.IsReady
                    and self.spy_sma.Window.Count >= 2
                    and self.previous_spy_close <= self.spy_sma.Window[1].Value
                    and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )
                spy_crosses_below = (
                    self.spy_sma.IsReady
                    and self.spy_sma.Window.Count >= 2
                    and self.previous_spy_close >= self.spy_sma.Window[1].Value
                    and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )
            else:
                spy_crosses_above = False
                spy_crosses_below = False

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_bar_valid = True
        else:
            spy_crosses_above = False
            spy_crosses_below = False
            self.previous_spy_bar_valid = False

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_bar_valid and self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            aapl_buy_reason = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            aapl_sell_reason = (
                self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > self.RSI_EXIT_THRESHOLD
            )

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
            self.previous_aapl_bar_valid = True
        else:
            aapl_buy_reason = False
            aapl_sell_reason = False
            self.previous_aapl_bar_valid = False
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        required_symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in required_symbols):
            return

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
            quantity = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and aapl_buy_reason:
            aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=100)
        self.spy_sma_previous = None
        self.spy_sma_current = None

        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        available = {}

        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if symbol in data.Bars:
                available[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]

        if self.spy in available:
            spy_close = float(available[self.spy].Close)
            prior_sma = self.spy_sma_current

            self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)

            if len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
                self.spy_sma_previous = prior_sma
                self.spy_sma_current = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0

        if self.aapl in available:
            aapl_close = float(available[self.aapl].Close)

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(available[self.aapl].EndTime, aapl_close)

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if len(available) != len(self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = float(available[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(available[self.aapl].Close)

        spy_buy = (
            self.spy_sma_previous is not None
            and self.spy_sma_current is not None
            and spy_close > self.spy_sma_current
            and float(self.spy_closes[-2]) <= self.spy_sma_previous
        )

        spy_sell = (
            self.strategy_a_lot > 0
            and self.spy_sma_previous is not None
            and self.spy_sma_current is not None
            and spy_close < self.spy_sma_current
            and float(self.spy_closes[-2]) >= self.spy_sma_previous
        )

        aapl_sell = (
            self.strategy_b_lot > 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 70.0
        )

        if spy_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if aapl_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_buy:
            quantity = int(
                math.floor(
                    0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
                )
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            cash_required = 20000.0
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= cash_required:
                quantity = int(math.floor(cash_required / aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity
